spec.name: Elena
spec.archetype: revenge-trader chasing back losses same day

versions.statement: Elena often increased her trade size impulsively after a losing trade to quickly recover her losses.
Elena was diligent in setting stop losses but frequently moved them further away as trades went against her.
Elena now consistently adheres to her predetermined stop-loss levels without adjustment, ensuring disciplined risk management.
Elena's primary goal was to achieve daily profitability regardless of the market conditions.
Elena found it difficult to maintain composure and often let the frustration from losses affect subsequent trades.
Elena has developed greater emotional resilience and can now detach emotionally, focusing on executing her trading plan objectively.
Elena preferred using technical analysis over fundamental analysis, relying heavily on chart patterns and technical indicators.
Elena tended to feel overconfident after a winning trade, which sometimes led to taking unnecessary risks without proper analysis.
